recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up one hosted heartbeat monitor outside `edna`: the script pings it only after a successful sync, and the monitor emails the user if the daily ping is late (deadline 03:00 plus normal runtime and margin).

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker; neither is needed to detect a missed run.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own notification, so a startup crash silences it.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: four startup failures, no email, and no independent alert.

note: It recommends a single heartbeat alert, keeps the existing summary email, explicitly leaves the Synology out, and the 'Checked myself' line uses only facts from the situation.
